notes: §1985:VII.3.5.3 SR1: "Data-name-1 is the name of a data record and must have an 01 level-number record description, with the same name, associated with it." FileControlBinder.BindFileSection calls ScreenDataRecords for each FD and SD with that entry's own records, and every name that is not a level-01 record of THIS entry is refused with COBOL6849. Probes at --std 85: DATA RECORD IS R1, DATA RECORDS ARE R1 R2 and DATA RECORDS R2 accepted and the program wrote and read the sequential, relative and indexed file; a subordinate item (R2A), a 66 RENAMES, a Working-Storage 01, another FD's 01, the SD's record named in the FD, an FD record named in the SD, an undefined name and a second name W1 beside R1 all refused COBOL6849; an 01 whose name another FD repeats resolves to this FD's record; an empty list (COBOL0001), a qualified name and the clause written twice (COBOL2423) are refused. Edition arm: 2002 and 2023 refuse the clause, COBOL0873 (VisitDataRecordsClause). Witness: DATA RECORD IS names an 02 item, refused COBOL6849.

next.reason: 1985: "Data-name-1 is the name of a data record and must have an 01 level-number record description, with the same name"; 2023: "No DATA RECORDS clause in 2023; no candidate clause holds the feature". The DATA RECORDS clause has no 2023 counterpart. No candidate covers naming data records in a file description; the candidates concern SAME AS, keys, message tags and other subjects.
